To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
AB BPM is a methodology that offers rapid and reliable business process improvement by combining process simulation with AB tests.

(1) AB BPM can be used to improve business processes in a continuous manner, (2) simulation can be used as a tool for process improvement validation, and (3) AB tests can be used to compare the performance of different versions of business processes and to determine the most efficient one.

AB BPM (i) is a methodology that combines process simulation and AB tests to improve business processes; (ii) provides a routing algorithm that ensures convergence towards the best version, regardless of its age; and (iii) can improve process performance by 10-15% in the case of real-life data.
